question: What outcome is said to follow from abstaining from food by day?
premises: Non-eating by day is identified as the means.
Death associated with age is the object concerned.
inference: Through abstaining from food by day, one will go to death associated with age.
uncertainties: The intended sense of vayo-mṛtyuṃ gamiṣyate is ambiguous and may be context-dependent.
plain_english: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go to the death of old age.
